localFacts.fact: KLM allows 1 piece of hand baggage of max. 55 x 35 x 25 cm including handles and wheels; all four full-size picks (31 / 39,4 / 40 / 43 cm folded) are shorter than 55 cm.
Rijksmuseum Boerhaave in Leiden: photographing and filming is allowed, but without flash and without a tripod.
Rijksmuseum: visitors may photograph and film without disturbing others; for bridal photography its terms say no tripods and no extra lighting.
Dutch terms: statiefkop, balhoofd, middenkolom, snelkoppelplaat; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: The a6400 has no IBIS; owners who film on a tripod don't miss it, but handheld work does.
localPainPoints.fix: English post: no in-body stabilization, so a tripod matters more in low light; switch OSS off on the tripod and use the 2-second timer.

quotes.text: Ik gebruik eigenlijk altijd een statief dus het ontbreken van ibis is voor mij geen probleem.

localPainPoints.pain: The a6400 screen flips up, not to the side, which matters for vlogging with a mic.
localPainPoints.fix: English post: move a hot-shoe mic to a side bracket so the flipped screen stays visible.

quotes.text: Een naar de zijkant klappend scherm was nog beter geweest, maar dit is al een enorme vooruitgang op de A6000.

localPainPoints.pain: A tripod that folds small has more, thinner sections and is less stable.
localPainPoints.fix: Check height with the column pushed in and extend the thickest sections first (English setup advice).
